replacement_basis: Groq official deprecation guidance for llama-3.1-8b-instant
recovery_protocol: run safe Groq model-availability preflight with no inference
run the unchanged E14 DEV-only candidate
score only after fixed E14 outputs exist using E9 v3 and the private DEV oracle
apply the already preregistered E14 absolute acceptance thresholds unchanged
historical_comparison_rule: Do not interpret delta versus historical E13 measured on llama-3.1-8b-instant as a causal E14 policy effect. If a causal E13-versus-E14 delta is needed, remeasure both DEV-only candidates on the same replacement model without VALIDATION tuning.
gate_rule: The E14 DEV-only gate may still be evaluated on the replacement model because provider/model were not frozen, but the model substitution must be disclosed and the original failed attempt must be classified as provider-invalidated rather than policy failure.
